title: Here's my Pixel art horror Visual Novel made by using AI
author: Pixie________
selftext: Unfortunately it's not in English but you can still understand what is happening if you keep looking. I did not use any code it's only visual and was made for fun.

comments.author: One-Area-2896
comments.body: How did you manage to have relatively consistent style? What’s your workflow?

replies.author: Pixie________
replies.body: I used Gemini to generate the characters and objects while prompting for a consistent style, then photoroom to edit them and capcut to adjust the lighting and apply filters.

comments.author: Snoo-6077
comments.body: Hey what engine did you use?

replies.author: Pixie________
replies.body: I didn't use an engine, it's just a video edit made from assembled assets.

replies.author: Ohgood9002
replies.body: So this is just a video? Not an actual game or project?
